R_controls.float: CPU float64 SVD; feature transforms emitted float32
R_controls.source: exact first KeyEncoder Linear W1 from frozen O2.1b b1_best.pt
R_controls.svd: W1=U diag(S) Vh; thin full-rank SVD

determinism.numerical_reextraction_sample: up to 64 accepted rows per split, selected by ascending SHA256(feature_row_id); re-tokenize source text, re-locate the frozen exact mention, then re-forward original full extraction batches with identical source composition and padding width

predeclared_tolerance.basis: bf16 model computation, float32 cache, same device/software and identical original batch composition

determinism.source_order: fixed split order then episode metadata order then item position

fact_eligibility: Every source fact enumerated by split -> metadata episode order -> item position; no count cap or prefix truncation.

j_stages.Z1: KeyEncoder.net[0] Linear(2048->256), includes frozen bias, pre-activation

labels.joint: sorted unique (entity_raw, relation_id) pairs observed in train; unseen pair or unknown entity -> -1
labels.relation: source relation_ids integer; relation string retained

mention_matching.acceptance: exactly one occurrence; accepted mention_id is <canonical_fact_id>:m0
mention_matching.multiple_occurrences: exclude with multiple_matches; record all candidate spans; never choose first
mention_matching.noncontiguous_mapping: exclude with token_span_noncontiguous; never silently use a bounding interval
mention_matching.normalization: none; entity_normalized is recorded as entity_raw; exact Unicode codepoint, case-sensitive literal match
mention_matching.overlapping_occurrences: count all, advancing search by one codepoint
mention_matching.token_mapping: token offsets overlap the unique character span; token span is [min_index,max_index+1)

primary_j_input_H.base_component: source MR train/val/test data NPZ fact_H, joined by canonical source fact flat_fact_index; the NPZ is hashed and never prefix-aligned
primary_j_input_H.formula: MR cache fact_H addressed by fact_offsets + 2.0 * fresh entity-mention mean hidden state
primary_j_input_H.name: fresh J-I2b carrier

source_hidden_state.pooling: arithmetic mean of selected mention token hidden states
source_hidden_state.selected_state: OuroModel hidden_states_list[-1], final UT pass (total_ut_steps-1), after the model RMSNorm; not a memory write state

tokenization.padding: right; batch-dynamic, pad to batch maximum
tokenization.persisted_inputs: input_ids, offsets and mention span are included in mention_resolution_manifest.jsonl before forward
tokenization.source: local pinned tokenizer assets in source_snapshot/Ouro-1.4B
